description: Counts the objects the running game holds by class, and compares two snapshots to show what an action kept alive. Only for a game this server started, whose editor_run start answered through gdharness. Needs an engine with debug features. Operations: snapshot: count the objects by class, most first, and keep the counts under an id; diff (needs before): each class whose count changed between two snapshots of the same run, biggest change first.

after.description: The id of the later snapshot. Default a snapshot taken now, kept and named. For op diff.

before.description: The id of the earlier snapshot, such as s1. For op diff.

name: debug_objects
title: Object snapshots
